result:
Solution B is correct and Solution A is not.

The robot covers 1 kilometer, which is 1000 meters, in 2.5 hours. Since 2.5 × 3600 = 9000 seconds, its speed is 1000/9000 = 1/9 m/s. Over 90 seconds it covers (1/9) × 90 = 10 meters.

Solution A makes a unit error. It writes "1 kilometer" as "2500 meters," which is wrong. It then computes (2500/9000) × 90 = 25, so its answer of 25 inherits that mistake. The method is sound, but the input value is incorrect.

Solution B converts the units correctly, computes the speed correctly, and gets the right answer of 10 meters.

WINNER: B
